products.name: Chimney Finding Follow-Up
products.product: A focused chimney inspection finding follow-up workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent chimney sweep, inspection, and fireplace-service companies
products.problem: Inspection findings, customer explanations, repair options, and seasonal timing split across reports and inboxes, leaving important decisions unresolved.
products.valueProposition: Turns chimney inspection finding follow-up into a visible operating queue so every material finding reaches a documented customer decision and an owned next action.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets chimney inspection finding follow-up software, chimney inspection finding follow-up tracker, chimney inspection finding follow-up template, and chimney inspection finding follow-up checklist searches.
